{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|eff= local

|gr1= GUI

|descr= Types a structured text on the screen, letter by letter, cursor blinking.<br>
[[File:BIS_fnc_typeText.gif|left|400px]]

|s1= [stringLines, posX, posY, rootFormat] spawn [[BIS_fnc_typeText]]

|p1= stringLines:
* [[Array]] of [[String]]s - array containing lines of text with same structured text formatting.
* [[Array]] of [[Array]]s format [text, format, blinkCount]:
** text: [[String]] - (Optional, default "")
** format: [[String]] - (Optional, default "<t align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '0.7'>%1</t>&lt;br/&gt;")
** blinkCount: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 5) number of cursor blinks after text typing

|p2= posX: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0)

|p3= posY: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0)

|p4= rootFormat: [[String]] - (Optional, default "<t>%1</t>") the parent format

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
[
	[
		["CAMP ROGAIN,", "<t align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '0.7' font='PuristaBold'>%1</t>"],
		["RESUPPLY POINT", "<t align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '0.7'>%1</t><br/>"],
		["10 MINUTES LATER ...", "<t align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '1.0'>%1</t>", 15]
	]
] spawn BIS_fnc_typeText;
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[
	[
		["Hello there...", nil, 30]
	],
	0, safeZoneY + safeZoneH / 2
] spawn BIS_fnc_typeText;</sqf>

|exec= spawn

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_dynamicText]] [[BIS_fnc_infoText]] [[BIS_fnc_textTiles]] [[BIS_fnc_typeText2]]
}}
